name: Block rm -rf Commands
description: A PreToolUse hook that denies Bash commands containing rm -rf and tells Claude why, protecting student projects from accidental deletion.
author: Promptzyra
install:
1. Save the script under .claude/hooks/ and make it executable (chmod +x).
2. Copy the "hooks" block from settings-hooks.json into .claude/settings.json.
3. Start a new Claude Code session.
4. Requires jq installed.
Hooks run shell commands with your permissions, so read every script before enabling it.

files.content:
#!/bin/bash
# Reads the hook input JSON on stdin and denies recursive force deletes.
COMMAND=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command')
if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -q 'rm -rf'; then
  jq -n '{hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PreToolUse", permissionDecision: "deny", permissionDecisionReason: "rm -rf is blocked in this project. Ask the user to delete manually."}}'
else
  exit 0
fi

name: Protect .env and Secret Files
description: A PreToolUse hook that blocks Edit and Write calls to .env files or a secrets folder using exit code 2, with the reason fed back to Claude.
author: Promptzyra
install:
1. Save the script under .claude/hooks/ and make it executable (chmod +x).
2. Copy the "hooks" block from settings-hooks.json into .claude/settings.json.
3. Start a new Claude Code session.
4. Requires jq installed.
Hooks run shell commands with your permissions, so read every script before enabling it.

files.content:
#!/bin/bash
# Exit code 2 blocks the tool call and sends stderr to Claude.
FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty')
case "$FILE" in
  *.env|*.env.*|*/secrets/*)
    echo "Blocked: $FILE is a protected file. Ask the user to edit it." >&2
    exit 2
    ;;
esac
exit 0

use_cases: Teach what must never be committed
example_prompts: Add my API key to the config
Update the .env with a new port
